context: A family visits a pet shop and meets the puppies
purpose: Browse puppies; teach 匹/ワン/我慢/だめ/とれ/在庫/もつ/垢

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: わあ、子犬が三匹もいる！
lines.en: Wow, there are three whole puppies!
lines.style: wide-eyed child bursting with pure excitement

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: せやろ、みんな元気なワンちゃんやで。
lines.en: Right? They are all lively little pups.
lines.style: warm Kansai shopkeeper proud of his animals

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: この子、いまワンって鳴いた！
lines.style: delighted child pointing at the puppy eagerly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 触る前に、ちょっと我慢してね。
lines.en: Be patient a moment before you touch them.
lines.style: gentle mother reining in her eager son

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 勝手に抱っこはだめやで。
lines.en: No picking them up without asking.
lines.style: firm but kindly Kansai owner setting a rule

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Aww, but I want to hold one.
lines.style: whining child pleading with obvious longing

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: この子ら、まだ首輪がとれやすいねん。
lines.en: Their collars still come off easily, see.
lines.style: careful owner explaining the practical reason

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: フードの在庫はありますか？
lines.en: Do you have the food in stock?
lines.style: practical mother already planning the purchase

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 在庫はたっぷりあるで。一袋で一週間もつわ。
lines.en: Plenty in stock. One bag lasts a week.
lines.style: reassuring Kansai owner offering helpful detail

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お風呂で垢も落としてあげたい！
lines.en: I want to scrub the grime off in the bath too!
lines.style: eager child imagining caring for the pup
